how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for SDHM Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: within 20 days from the date of notification.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: SDHM Kerala Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SDHM Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SDHM Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SDHM Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: within 20 days from the date of notification. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for SDHM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The State Digital Health Mission / eHealth Kerala has announced a total of 10 vacancies for various positions including Software Engineer, Junior Developer, and Procurement Assistant under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SDHM recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is within 20 days from the date of notification, which is 24 September 2026. Therefore, candidates must submit their applications by 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply via email only. Applications must be sent to [email protected] in the prescribed format. Physical applications will not be accepted by the organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Software Engineer (JAVA) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Software Engineer (JAVA) position will be offered a monthly salary of Rs. 50,000/- as per the official notification issued by the SDHM.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts advertised by the State Digital Health Mission / eHealth Kerala for the 2026 recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Junior Developer (JAVA) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Developer (JAVA) position is 30 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this criteria before applying.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SDHM recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts will be based on a written test and/or a personal interview conducted by the selection committee of the State Digital Health Mission.

faq.question: Q8. What are the educational qualifications required for the Procurement Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Procurement Assistant post must possess a B.COM, M.COM, or MBA degree along with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in procurement, finance, or administration.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the positions offered by the State Digital Health Mission / eHealth Kerala under this notification are on a contract basis. Candidates should be aware of the contractual nature of the employment.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the job be located?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidates will be in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, as the recruitment is being conducted by the State Digital Health Mission / eHealth Kerala based in that city.
